does: Runs the queue of load states: while the active state (+0x28) is not done (its virtual +0x28) it waits; when done and another is queued (count +0x1C) it ends it (virtual +0x20), destroys it (virtual +0x8) and starts the next (virtual +0x10, then +0x18 while the screen is visible, +0x8)

evidence.says: macOS decomp; the queue is a ring at +0x10 with capacity +0x18, count +0x1C, head +0x20
the macOS build's symbols hold this name
GameEngine.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
